data.name: Iffatan
data.gender_notes: Iffatan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'iftatha', meaning 'gift' or 'grace'. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that children are a gift from Allah. The name Iffatan carries the meaning “Gift, Grace” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Iffatan usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Iffatan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Iffatan total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: إفطان
in_arabic.meaning: إفطان يعني الفتى الذي يفط عن المعاصي و يترك الذنوب

in_english.name: Iffatan
